text: Implemented compile-time rank evidence on fixed-arity apply/update for ranks 1-4 across owned, borrowed, and mutable arrays; rank zero, wrong arities, dynamic rank, and ranks >4 no longer receive those methods. transpose requires static Rank[2]; transpose2D returns Either[RankMismatch,...] for dynamic owned/borrowed/mutable paths. A Scala 3.7.4 prototype records why rank-specific extension overloads are not viable and validates evidence-gated class members instead. Exhaustive compileErrors and runtime bounds tests pass on JVM/JS. Full fmtCheck, testAllFull (164 JVM core, 162 JS core, all experimental suites, 3 Chromium), representationProof, optimized links, and docsCheck passed; browser audits were clean before/after.
